# Dataset contract

**Source:** Original synthetic fixtures generated by `generate_data.py`. No third-party data or real people are included.

**Seed:** 202704. Included data is CC0-1.0 under the root DATA_LICENSE.md. All dates refer to fictional 2025 records.

## Grain and field meaning

Orders have one row per order_id with customer_id, product_id, quantity and unit_price_cents. Customer and product files each have one row per natural key.

## Fixture inventory

### `customers.csv`
50 records.

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | int64 | `1` |
| `region` | object | `South` |

### `orders.csv`
500 records.

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | int64 | `1` |
| `customer_id` | int64 | `37` |
| `product_id` | int64 | `9` |
| `quantity` | int64 | `3` |
| `unit_price_cents` | int64 | `9293` |

### `products.csv`
20 records.

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | int64 | `1` |
| `category` | object | `Tech` |

## Intentional edge cases

Attempt an invalid foreign key insert, verify it fails, reconcile every source amount and count facts assigned to the unknown dimension member.

## Regeneration

`python generate_data.py` recreates the fixture files. It does not rerun the pipeline. The generator source is the authoritative construction recipe.

## Validation boundary

This warehouse is SQLite at teaching scale. Dimensions are static in this project; historical attribute changes are covered separately in the SCD Type 2 project.
